call_points.text: The next lot of B200 GPUs is expected to go live this quarter.
Management views the business as a 70% plus EBITDA margin model over the medium to long term.
No MRR or revenue guidance; management asked investors to look at past quarterly exit MRR instead.
Next B200 lot expected in the next couple of months; plans also include more Blackwell and Vera Rubin capacity.
Existing fleet utilisation is at maximum versus any previous quarter; growth is expected mainly from capacity additions, not the July price hike.
Management declined to quantify peak debt for the year.
Funding for announced GPUs is arranged via debt, internal accruals or prior equity raises; no new equity raise announced.
Revenue mix: India AI Mission about 20-21%, international about 37%, rest domestic.
SovCloud is an infrastructure subsidiary for large-scale CPU clusters; the Delaware entity handles international sales and alliances.
On AI bubble and commoditisation worries, management said it is still 'day zero' of a decadal AI build-out.
First cluster of 1,024 B200 GPUs is scheduled to go live by mid-May 2026.
Government/India AI Mission business accounted for 35% to 40% of Q4 revenue.
International customers contributed roughly 35% to 37% of Q4 revenue.
Management expects GPU contribution to revenue to reach 85%-90% in coming quarters.
Exploring private credit and asset-light partnerships, including an MOU with L&T.
GPU fixed assets carry a 6-year amortization/depreciation schedule.

operating_notes.text: March 2026 overall capacity utilization was over 80% with March MRR reaching ₹37.4 Cr.
International revenue contributed approximately 35% to 37% in Q4FY26.
New GPU fixed block is depreciated over a 6-year useful life.
Secured a USD 7.7 Million (approx. ₹73 Cr) 6-month agreement with a USA-based AI service provider for GPU cloud computing and allied services.
Received in-principle approval from BSE for direct listing of equity shares.
Board approved a wholly owned subsidiary in India for deploying large-scale GPU infrastructure and facilitating funding arrangements, and one in Delaware, USA for international market access.
Postal ballot on the share split and MoA/AoA amendments passed with 99.997% assent; voting capital was 2,05,56,489 shares of ₹10 each.
Went live with next-generation NVIDIA B200 cluster using NVIDIA Certified Reference Architecture on the TIR AI/ML Platform.
Live GPU capacity is nearly 5,100, excluding another 1,024 B200 expected in the next couple of months.
India AI Mission was about 20-21% of revenue and international about 37%, with the rest domestic.
Management said the existing fleet is at maximum utilisation versus any previous quarter, and growth will come mainly from capacity additions rather than the July price hike.
Sovcloud Technologies Limited was incorporated as a wholly owned subsidiary on June 17, 2026, and had not commenced operations as of September 30, 2026.
Signed a multi-year cloud GPU contract worth ~₹1,000 Cr valid through June 2029.
The company reallocated ₹149.12 Cr from General Corporate Purposes to IT equipment capex following a shareholder resolution on September 26, 2025.
Revenue from India AI customers is roughly around 13% to 15% for Q2FY27.
International revenue is roughly around 20% to 25% for Q2FY27.
Proposed capacity addition of ~5.4 MW for NVIDIA HGX B300 systems and other Blackwell GPUs, funded via internal accruals and debt.
E2E Networks announced a capacity expansion of nearly 59% to approximately 14.6 MW, adding about 5.4 MW of NVIDIA HGX B300 systems and other Blackwell GPUs.

Mr. Ankush Agarwal, Partner of M/s Maks & Co., confirmed all resolutions in E2E Networks Limited’s Postal Ballot passed via e-Voting on April 27, 2026.
E2E Networks secured a USD 7.7 million (approx. ₹73 Cr) 6-month GPU cloud computing agreement with a US-based AI service provider.
Tarun Dua, as Promoter and acting on behalf of Promoter Group and Persons Acting in Concert, declared no new encumbrances on E2E Networks shares during FY2025-26.

E2E Networks' board approved incorporating wholly owned subsidiaries in India (for GPU infrastructure and funding arrangements) and in Delaware, USA (for international market access), with incorporation to start within two weeks.
On 21 May 2026, E2E Networks shareholders passed all three postal-ballot resolutions — the equity share sub-division, the MoA capital clause amendment and the AoA amendment — with 99.997% assent.
E2E Networks went live with its next-generation NVIDIA B200 cluster on the TIR AI/ML Platform.

Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹223.76 Cr, net profit ₹72.7 Cr.
E2E Networks reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹223.76 Cr and signed a ~₹1,000 Cr sovereign AI contract.

E2E Networks reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹223.8 Cr and PAT of ₹72.7 Cr, driven by strong demand for AI cloud infrastructure.

E2E Networks announced a plan to expand its AI factory capacity by ~5.4 MW to approximately 14.6 MW using NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs.
